name: Cat with Tears of Joy
baseMeaning: A cat face laughing so hard it has tears streaming from its eyes.
tldr: 😹 marks something as extremely funny, as if the cat is laughing hard enough to cry.

contextMeanings.meaning: The emoji literally shows a cat laughing with tears streaming from its eyes.
contextMeanings.example: that cat looks like it's laughing until it tears up 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: In a casual chat, 😹 is a playful reaction to something genuinely funny or ridiculous.
contextMeanings.example: that plot twist was absolutely insane 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: When paired with teasing or shared history, 😹 can show playful amusement and warm interest.
contextMeanings.example: you remembered my terrible joke from three dates ago 😹

contextMeanings.meaning: Among colleagues who already trade jokes, 😹 can react to an absurd or mildly frustrating situation.
contextMeanings.example: the printer really chose today to jam on every page 😹

platformNotes.note: On iMessage, 😹 often closes a funny story in a familiar conversation, where its exaggerated reaction fits the warm, casual tone. It works especially well after a punchline sent by a friend.
On Instagram, people use 😹 in comments and direct messages to react to a ridiculous post, caption, or shared update. The cat adds personality to a short reaction without requiring a paragraph.

On TikTok, 😹 commonly appears in the comments after a clip, meme, or unexpected moment makes the viewer laugh. It functions as a quick way to say that the video was funny enough to prompt an exaggerated reaction.
In Slack, 😹 works best in casual channels with colleagues who already share memes and complaints. Using it beside a genuine workplace problem may make the response look careless rather than funny.

generationalNotes.note: Gen Z generally recognizes 😹 as a familiar reaction to a funny moment, particularly in quick friend-thread conversations. Its exaggerated cat face suits short, informal exchanges.
Millennials often use 😹 in the same playful way: the cat makes an amusing update or punchline feel funnier and more animated.
Gen X may need the surrounding message to distinguish 😹 from the crying cat 😿 because both faces show tears. In a clearly funny thread, however, it reads as laughter.

warnings.title: Confused with sadness
warnings.description: Because 😹 is beside 😿, some people may initially read the tears as distress. If the message is actually sad, send 😿 or write plainly instead of relying on the cat to carry the meaning.

seoTitle: 😹 Cat with Tears of Joy Emoji Meaning
seoDescription: What does 😹 mean? It marks a moment as extremely funny, as if a cat is laughing so hard that tears of joy are streaming down its face.

longForm.overview:
😹 is a cat face laughing so hard that tears stream from its eyes. The tears are part of the laughter, not a report that the sender is upset. It is the animal version of a helpless “laugh till you cry” reaction: the joke landed, the moment felt especially funny, and the cat makes the excess visible.

In a friend thread, 😹 usually means “this is funny, and the cat makes it funnier.” It works well after a punchline, a ridiculous screenshot, or an update that is more absurd than expected. The sender is not asking for sympathy; they are adding a playful emotional layer to something they want the group to enjoy together.

The nearest neighbor is 😿, the crying cat. 😿 softens sadness, while 😹 turns the same visible tears into laughter. Choosing the wrong one can change the whole emotional direction, so the surrounding message matters. When a post really is sad, use 😿 or plain words rather than relying on the cat to explain itself.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
😹 most often appears beside the thing that made everyone laugh: a bad pun, a pet doing something impossible, or a friend describing an embarrassing moment. It can stand alone as the reaction, but it often works as punctuation after the actual story, turning “I cannot believe this happened” into a shared punchline.

People also use it when an update is simply too ridiculous for a normal reply. A photo of the wrong pizza order or a screenshot of an absurd message can be followed by 😹 to say, “yes, this is genuinely funny.” The cat gives the reaction personality without needing a long explanation.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Skip 😹 when the conversation is genuinely painful, such as a breakup, illness, or a loss. The laughing face will feel tonally wrong because its purpose is to celebrate the funny side of a moment. 😿 is the better cat when tears are meant as sadness, and plain language is better when the message needs to be taken seriously.

It also has less room for jokes in professional chats. If a coworker sends mildly annoying news, asks for help, or reports a real problem, a response full of 😹 may sound flippant even if the sender was being playful. Keep 😹 for casual exchanges among people who already trade jokes; otherwise state the issue directly and save the cat for a moment everyone can laugh at together.
longForm.howToReply:
If someone sends 😹, reply with 😹 when you also found the moment funny; mirroring keeps the joke moving without forcing anyone to explain it. You can also send 😂, add 😹 to the screenshot or link they are reacting to, or answer with the specific part that made you laugh. “the way you said ‘no worries’ 😭” gives the cat something to point at and often invites more stories.

If 😹 appears under your own post, treat it as approval of the joke, not a brush-off. Thank the person or ask which line got them. If you were not joking and the conversation had become tense, a quick “I was being serious—everything okay?” can clear up the mismatch. If the reply lands badly, apologize and switch to clearer words rather than adding more laughing cats.

faqs.question: What does 😹 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: It usually means he found something funny, often in a playful or teasing way. If it accompanies a personal comment about you, it may also show amused interest, but the emoji alone does not establish that he is flirting.

faqs.question: Is 😹 flirty?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. 😹 normally reacts to humor, while context decides whether the message feels flirty, such as when it follows a joke about an inside memory from your first date.

faqs.question: What does 😹 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: In TikTok comments, it is an exaggerated reaction to a funny or ridiculous clip. It says that the video made the viewer laugh hard enough to cry.

faqs.question: Why is 😹 next to 😿?
faqs.answer: They are neighboring cat emojis with opposite uses. 😹 shows tears from laughter, while 😿 shows a softer expression of sadness.

conversationExamples.message: okay you remembering that disaster from our second date might actually be the smoothest thing you've done 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is teasing that shows amused interest and affection. Reply with a playful correction or laugh along rather than treating it like a serious compliment.

conversationExamples.message: my cat just brought me the tax forms. official invoice apparently 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender is sharing an absurd domestic moment that made them laugh. React with 😹, add a joke about the cat's billing rates, or send a photo of your own pet doing something equally unhelpful.

conversationExamples.message: the office printer has jammed on every single page of the quarterly report 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: This only works as humor if the group normally shares complaints. A light reaction is fine, but someone should still help resolve the printing problem.

conversationExamples.message: uncle's vacation photo has three airport signs and zero visible relatives 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: The family member is gently roasting the confusing vacation photo. Laugh with them or ask which sign the actual relatives were standing near.

conversationExamples.message: the guy at the party just introduced himself with the wrong name twice 😹
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is a retelling of an awkward social moment that the sender found funny. React with 😹 if you understand the joke, but avoid retelling it if the person involved might be nearby.
